outline: 本課程旨在幫助學生熟稔運用基本重要文法以寫出正確自然, 表達清晰之句子.  內容包括語法結構和錯誤分析, 例如不完整句、誤置修飾語、不連結修飾語、散漫句、錯誤平行結構、易混淆字、贅詞等常見問題。
schedule:
W1 Course Introduction, Participial Phrases
W2 228 Memorial Day (no class)
W3 Participial Phrases (cont.), Gerund Phrases
W4 Gerund Phrases (cont.), Infinitive Phrases
W5 Absolute Constructions
W6 Abstract Noun Phrases
W7 Children's Day (no class)
W8 Appositive Phrases
W9 Mid-term
W10 Writing Process & Paragraph Structure
W11 Narrating
W12 Narrating (cont.)
W13 Describing
W14 Describing (cont.)
W15 Explaining
W16 Explaining (cont.)
W17 Comparing/Contrasting
W18 Comparing/Contrasting (cont.) & Final
Final exam
assessment: Class activities & pop quizzes (25%); assignments (35%); mid-term (25%); final (15%).
